answer: An agent economy resists Sybil attacks by making each identity post a non-transferable stake its own peers can slash. A newcomer must fund a bond and pass review before transacting, so a thousand fake personas need a thousand real bonds. The registry is a narrow inlet into a walled harbor: one guard, and massed fake boats cannot slip through. Reputation is a shared nebula of attested history; honest agents hang a lantern of recorded labor, while copycats stay dark. For an attacker the cost compounds: locked capital, sustained plausible work, and total forfeiture on detection.
